skill1: Activates if the skill user is in Metal γ status when an ally is out of action. Affects 1 incapacitated ally unit(s) with the highest final ATK (except the skill user). Resurrect with 96% HP.
Activates when an ally is out of action. Affects self. Removes Metal γ.
skill2: Activates when entering Full Burst. Affects 1 ally unit(s) with the longest basic Charge Time. Charge Time ▼ 0.18 sec for 10 sec.

caveats: ⚑ Metal σ is modeled as a 0/1 resource pool. The restore block (fullBurstEnd + ownBurstGate 'cast') is an interpretation of "has cast Burst Skill before Full Burst ends"; confirm ownBurstGate composes with a fullBurstEnd trigger in the engine, else re-key the restore to a burstCast trigger (identical cadence whenever she bursts every rotation, off-by-one-cycle when she skips one).

⚑ perResource on burstGenPct assumes the live-resource buff path is read by the gauge accumulator. Fallback if not: a plain passive burstGenPct 70.4, which over-credits gauge during the window where σ is consumed (FB-enter → FB-end).

⚑ S2's Charge Time ▼ 0.18 sec is NOT modeled: no flat charge-time primitive (schema has only chargeSpeedPct) and no "longest basic Charge Time" target kind. If enacted, chargeSpeedPct ≈ 100 × 0.18 / baseChargeSec on the single charge-weapon ally.

⚑ S1 team heal read as RECURRING every 10 normal attacks; only the S1 ATK line carries an explicit "Activates once per battle". The heal AMOUNT (2.04% of caster final Max HP) is not modeled — the engine has no HP pool; the recovery EVENT is the modeled part.
⚑ Cadence tuple (ammo 60 / reloadFrames 121 / AR pulls-per-sec) is datamined and unverified for this unit.
⚑ Burst DoT: crit left OFF (global DOT_CRIT gate) and noFb unset (Full Burst applied by tick timing). Both are measured-only fields.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Authored from kit text only, with no board exposure. Metal γ (S1) is a permanent self ATK ▲58.08%: its sole removal condition is an ally going out of action, which cannot occur in v1 (no HP pool, immortal roster), so the γ status gate on the S1 team heal is likewise always satisfied and the heal is modeled as an ungated hitCount:10 recovery event to all allies (event only — no HP amount; it exists to feed on-recovery consumers). Metal σ (S2) is modeled as a 0/1 resource: initial 1, read live by a perResource burstGenPct passive (σ=1 → +70.4%, σ=0 → 0), consumed by the Full-Burst-enter block that grants Attack Damage ▲21.12% and ATK ▲63.36% for 10s, and restored at Full-Burst end when the owner cast her own burst that rotation. Burst = a self Sustained Damage ▲52.8% for 10s plus one 396%-of-final-ATK sustained DoT ticking every 1s for 10s (one appended instance per cast). The S2 Full-Burst-enter Charge Time ▼0.18 sec to the longest-basic-charge-time ally is deliberately unmodeled — the schema carries neither a flat charge-time primitive nor that target kind.

flags.reasoning: "has cast Burst Skill before Full Burst ends" is evaluated at FB end, so σ present at FB N ⟺ she burst in cycle N-1 (or N=1, from battle start). A burstCast-keyed restore instead makes it σ present ⟺ she bursts in cycle N — identical whenever she bursts every rotation, shifted by one cycle when she skips.
flags.recipe: Run the control comp with ROT=1 and log buffApply for atkPct 63.36; count the FB entries that fire the buff. Compare against the rotation log's list of cycles in which mana actually cast. If ownBurstGate is not evaluated on fullBurstEnd, the block will either never or always fire — that shows up immediately as 0 or every-FB applications.

flags.estimate: 70.4% while σ=1, 0% while σ=0 (i.e. off for the ~10s between FB enter and FB end)
flags.reasoning: The kit ties the gauge speed to the σ STATUS, which the FB-enter block removes. perResource is the schema's live-pool primitive; a plain passive would keep +70.4% after removal. Practical impact is small because gauge accrual during Full Burst is minimal — the real consequence is a rotation losing σ permanently if she stops bursting.
flags.recipe: Toggle the perResource form against a plain passive burstGenPct 70.4 in the control comp; compare measured full-burst counts. If they match, the distinction is board-inert and either encoding is safe; if they differ, the σ cycle is load-bearing for rotation and needs a footage FB-count check.

flags.estimate: ≈ chargeSpeedPct +18% for 10s on one ally with a 1.0s base charge (0.18/1.0)
flags.reasoning: Flat seconds, not a percentage; the schema exposes only chargeSpeedPct, and the target set ("1 ally with the longest basic Charge Time") has no matching TargetDef. The percentage equivalent is therefore team-dependent — a 0.6s charge ally gets ~30%, a 2.0s ally ~9%.
flags.recipe: Add an alliesLongestChargeTime target kind (or a flat chargeTimeSecFlat effect) before enacting. Until then, score the gap by hand: pick the charge-weapon ally in the comp, compute 100×0.18/baseChargeSec, and A/B that as a 10s chargeSpeedPct grant on FB enter to bound the missing damage.

flags.estimate: recurring every 10 landed normal attacks (rounds, not trigger pulls)
flags.reasoning: The S1 ATK line explicitly says "Activates once per battle"; this line does not, so the recurrence reading is the literal one. AR hitsPerShot is 1, so rounds == pulls here and the distinction is inert for this unit.
flags.recipe: Count buffApply/recovery events in the control comp: at ~12 pulls/s over 180s the heal should fire on the order of 100+ times. If footage shows a single early heal, re-key to a one-shot.

flags.estimate: noFb unset (Full Burst applied per tick by timing); crit unset (global DOT_CRIT gate, default OFF)
flags.reasoning: Both are measured-only fields per the ALWAYS-⚑ taxonomy. Most DoTs in this roster are validated non-crit; a burst-cast DoT's ticks span the FB window, so ~10 of 10 ticks land in or near it and the FB major materially moves the number.
flags.recipe: Read burst-DoT popups off a recording: orange/icon bodies ⇒ set crit:true; compare tick magnitudes inside vs outside the FB window for the ×1.5 step to confirm/refute noFb.

flags.reasoning: rate_of_fire and reloadFrames are known-unreliable datamine fields, and they gate both the hitCount:10 heal cadence and total shot count. A nominal rate is also not the effective rate (60fps frame quantization).
flags.recipe: Read the ammo counter off footage over a fixed window for shots/sec, and time a reload start→full for the reload frames; both are direct measurements of the disputed quantities.
